title: "Statistics"

---

Applied statistical work in R, from a consulting ANOVA to a group econometrics paper.

- [Holiday Cocoa Promotions (ANOVA)](Statistics/project1.qmd): A consulting report for a food company on whether promotions need to differ by region.
- [Weather Regression](Statistics/project2.qmd): A multiple linear regression comparing April 2023 temperatures in Phoenix and Renton.
- [Price of Promotion (Econometrics)](Statistics/project3.qmd): A group paper on how promotions relate to retail prices, using store-level panel data.
